description: Extension of OnboardingView providing UI and monitoring functions related to permissions, discovery, CLI installation, and gateway probing.

classes.name: OnboardingView
classes.description: A View component related to onboarding process, extended here with permission and discovery monitoring methods.

methods.name: refreshPerms
methods.description: Refreshes the permissions by invoking permissionMonitor's refreshNow method.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Requests a specific capability, manages 'isRequesting' state, and refreshes permissions after.

methods.name: updatePermissionMonitoring
methods.description: Enables or disables permission monitoring based on page index.

methods.name: updateDiscoveryMonitoring
methods.description: Controls discovery monitoring depending on page index, with delayed start for discovery.

methods.name: updateMonitoring
methods.description: Updates both permission and discovery monitoring based on the provided page index, and may start onboarding chat.

methods.name: installCLI
methods.description: Initiates CLI installation if not already in progress.

methods.name: refreshCLIStatus
methods.description: Updates CLI installation status and location.

methods.name: refreshLocalGatewayProbe
methods.description: Async function that describes local gateway port, checks command tokens, and updates localGatewayProbe state.
